description: This source file defines custom placement strategies and attributes for Orleans grains, including interfaces for grains, an enum for various scenarios, a custom placement strategy class, and an attribute for applying strategies.

classes.name: TestCustomPlacementStrategy
classes.description: A custom placement strategy class for Orleans that supports different placement scenarios such as FixedSilo, ExcludeOne, and RequestContextBased.

classes.name: TestPlacementStrategyAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class to assign custom placement strategies to Orleans grain classes based on specified scenarios.

methods.name: TestCustomPlacementStrategy()
methods.description: Default constructor for the custom placement strategy.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the placement strategy with grain properties, parsing the scenario key from properties.

methods.name: PopulateGrainProperties
methods.description: Populates grain properties with the current placement scenario as a string.

methods.name: TestPlacementStrategyAttribute()
methods.description: Constructor that creates a placement attribute with a specified scenario.

methods.name: GetCustomPlacementStrategy
methods.description: Static method that returns the corresponding placement strategy instance based on the scenario.
